intro: You've got the starter kit. These are the tools creators reach for next. Prices and free limits change often, so treat them as a guide and confirm on each tool's own site.

tools.name: Google Flow (Veo 3.1)
tools.best: Cinematic clips with sound, including vertical 9:16.
tools.free: 50 credits a day with no rollover, enough for a few short clips.
tools.paid: Google AI Pro is about $19.99 a month with 1,000 credits.
tools.earnNote: Check Google's terms for your plan before you monetize.
tools.tip: Start with the Lite or Fast model to save credits.
tools.watchOut: Free daily credits don't cover top-quality renders.

tools.name: Kling 3.0
tools.best: Strong value for longer, steadier clips.
tools.free: About 66 free credits a day, with a watermark.
tools.paid: Standard plans start at roughly $7 to $10 a month.
tools.earnNote: Free output is non-commercial. You need a paid plan to monetize.
tools.tip: Use image-to-video with your own character image to keep the look consistent.
tools.watchOut: The official pricing page is region-gated, so confirm inside the app.

tools.name: Runway Gen-4.5
tools.best: Creative control and editing tools in one place, with strong lip sync.
tools.free: A limited set of free credits that do not refill.
tools.paid: Paid plans start from around $12 a month. Check the site for current prices.
tools.earnNote: Read the plan's commercial terms before you publish for money.
tools.tip: It's good for editing clips you already have, not just generating new ones.
tools.watchOut: Credits go fast when you retry, so plan your shots first.

tools.name: Seedance 2.0
tools.best: Stylised looks and multi-input control, with sound generated together with video.
tools.free: Check Dreamina for the current free credits.
tools.paid: Pricing varies by region and plan. Check the site.
tools.earnNote: Confirm the commercial terms for your country and plan.
tools.tip: Great for painted, clay and other stylised looks.
tools.watchOut: Availability and pricing differ between countries.

tools.name: GPT Image 2 (in ChatGPT)
tools.best: Following long, detailed instructions and putting readable text inside images.
tools.free: Basic image creation on the free plan, with daily limits.
tools.paid: ChatGPT Plus is about $20 a month.
tools.earnNote: Check OpenAI's current terms for your plan.
tools.tip: Ask for edits in the same chat instead of starting over.
tools.watchOut: Limits change. Look under Settings, then Usage.

tools.name: Nano Banana 2 (in Gemini)
tools.best: The best free option, and strong at keeping one character consistent.
tools.free: Roughly 20 images a day in the Gemini app. Limits change.
tools.paid: Google AI Plus starts around $7.99 a month, and Pro at about $19.99 adds Nano Banana Pro.
tools.earnNote: Check Google's terms and any watermark rules before you monetize.
tools.tip: Upload your character and change one thing at a time.
tools.watchOut: Free outputs can be smaller and watermarked.

tools.name: Midjourney V8
tools.best: Painterly, artistic looks and strong art direction.
tools.free: No free tier.
tools.paid: From about $10 a month.
tools.earnNote: Commercial use is allowed on paid plans, and larger businesses need higher plans.
tools.tip: Use style references to keep a whole series looking the same.
tools.watchOut: Weaker than GPT Image at following long literal instructions.

tools.name: Ideogram
tools.best: Posters, thumbnails and any image that needs readable text.
tools.free: A small number of free credits each day.
tools.paid: Check the site for current plans.
tools.earnNote: Reported to allow commercial use on the free tier. Confirm in their terms.
tools.tip: Perfect for thumbnails and quote cards.
tools.watchOut: Always confirm the current terms on their site.

tools.name: ElevenLabs
tools.best: Natural voiceovers and narration in many languages, plus music with clear commercial licensing.
tools.free: A free plan with limited credits.
tools.paid: Starter is around $5 to $6 a month and adds a commercial licence.
tools.earnNote: Free output has no commercial licence and asks you to credit ElevenLabs in the title.
tools.tip: Narrate your own script, then adjust pace and pauses.
tools.watchOut: Don't clone anyone's voice without their permission. Starter music excludes streaming-service release.

tools.name: Suno
tools.best: Full songs with vocals from a text prompt.
tools.free: About 50 credits a day, roughly 10 songs.
tools.paid: Pro is about $8 a month billed yearly, or about $10 monthly.
tools.earnNote: Free songs are for personal use only. Commercial rights need Pro or Premier, and only cover songs made while you're subscribed.
tools.tip: Write your own lyrics first, then generate.
tools.watchOut: Record-label lawsuits over training data are still unresolved, which is a risk for client work.

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.best: Brainstorming, scripts, captions and quick image edits.
tools.free: A free plan with limits.
tools.paid: Plus is about $20 a month.
tools.tip: Give it your audience, tone and length every time.
tools.watchOut: Verify facts it states, especially dates and numbers.

tools.name: Gemini
tools.best: Research that uses Google's knowledge, plus image creation with Nano Banana.
tools.free: A free tier with daily limits.
tools.paid: Google AI Plus and Pro plans raise the limits.
tools.tip: Ask it to list its sources, then open them yourself.
tools.watchOut: Check any claim before it goes in a video.

tools.name: Claude
tools.best: Long documents, careful writing and structured planning.
tools.free: A free plan with limits.
tools.paid: Paid plans give higher limits.
tools.tip: Paste your whole script and ask for specific edits.
tools.watchOut: Verify facts, as with any AI tool.

tools.name: Perplexity
tools.best: Research answers with sources you can click.
tools.free: A free tier.
tools.paid: Paid plans add deeper research.
tools.tip: Use it for the facts, then write the script yourself.
tools.watchOut: Open the sources. Don't trust the summary alone.

tools.name: NotebookLM
tools.best: Upload your sources and ask questions about only those.
tools.free: Free to use, with limits.
tools.paid: Higher limits come with Google's paid plans.
tools.tip: Great for fact-checking a documentary script against your sources.
tools.watchOut: It only knows what you upload.

tools.name: CapCut
tools.best: Fast mobile and desktop editing with auto-captions.
tools.free: Core editing is free. Many effects and AI tools are paid or capped.
tools.paid: Roughly $9.99 (Standard) to $19.99 (Pro) a month, varying by region.
tools.earnNote: Check the licence on templates, music and effects before you monetize.
tools.tip: Save your caption style as a template so every video matches.
tools.watchOut: Prices vary by region and by where you subscribe.

tools.name: Descript
tools.best: Edit a video by editing its transcript, and remove filler words fast.
tools.free: A free plan with limits.
tools.paid: Check the site for current plans.
tools.tip: Great for explainers and voiceover-led videos.
tools.watchOut: Always listen to the final cut. Automatic cuts can clip words.

tools.name: OpusClip
tools.best: Turn one long video into several short clips with captions.
tools.free: Check the site for the current free plan.
tools.paid: Check the site for current plans.
tools.tip: Feed it your longer YouTube videos and pick the best three clips.
tools.watchOut: Review every clip. Auto-picked moments can miss context.

tools.name: Canva
tools.best: Thumbnails, quote cards, carousels and simple video.
tools.free: A free plan. Some assets are Pro-only.
tools.paid: Canva Pro is a paid plan.
tools.earnNote: Read the licence on stock elements, especially Pro-only ones.
tools.tip: Make a template for your thumbnails and reuse it.
tools.watchOut: Free plans limit some elements and downloads.

tools.name: Make
tools.best: Visual automations that connect your apps without code.
tools.free: 1,000 operations a month and 2 active scenarios.
tools.paid: Core is from about $9 to $11 a month.
tools.tip: Start with one scenario: a new idea in Sheets, a script from ChatGPT, saved in Docs.
tools.watchOut: Every step uses operations, so keep scenarios short.

tools.name: Zapier
tools.best: The simplest setup and the most app connections.
tools.free: 100 tasks a month and 5 Zaps.
tools.paid: Paid plans start at about $20 to $30 a month.
tools.tip: Use it for one simple job, like saving form replies to a sheet.
tools.watchOut: The free plan runs out fast if your automation has several steps.

tools.name: n8n
tools.best: The most flexible option, and the strongest for AI-powered workflows.
tools.free: Self-hosting is free with no execution limits. You pay for your own server.
tools.paid: Cloud plans start at about $20 a month (2,500 executions).
tools.tip: Try the cloud trial before you attempt self-hosting.
tools.watchOut: Self-hosting needs technical setup and ongoing upkeep.

retired: OpenAI shut down Sora in 2026 (the web app on April 26 and the API on September 24). If a tool is sold to you as Sora access, it isn't an official product. Veo 3.1, Kling, Runway and Seedance are the main alternatives.
